notes: Obsidian Glint 1.4.0, and the whole Control Panel now moves at the theme's pace. Every animation in the app was timed by numbers no theme could reach; the theme's own timings — noticeably quicker than the defaults — now drive all of them.
Arriving and leaving are no longer the same motion. One curve was doing both jobs, which made anything being dismissed look like it faded rather than left.

The theme author raised these as a formal report rather than working around them quietly. Two of the three are fixed here; the third needs a product decision and is written down rather than guessed at.
